suites.title: Valid SDK authentication auto-logs in to CXone Agent

specs.title: should redirect to CXone OIDC login on Authenticate click
should enable navigation tabs after auth_token is set in localStorage
should display AUTHENTICATED status and token after successful auth
should load CXone Agent iframe on CXA Placeholder page after auth
should post auth token to CXone Agent iframe via postMessage
should not authenticate with empty hostname
should not authenticate with empty clientId
should not authenticate with empty redirectUri
should not authenticate with all fields empty
should keep tabs disabled when authentication fails
OIDC token endpoint should reject invalid authorization code
should show AUTHENTICATION_FAILED or NOT_AUTHENTICATED status on failure

suites.title: Logout from SDK logs out from CXone Agent

specs.title: should clear localStorage when logout action executes
should redirect to home (/) after logout
should disable navigation tabs after logout
NavBar Logout handler should call endSession in source code
CXone Agent iframe should not persist after logout navigation
should detect auth_token removal from localStorage (external logout)
should handle NOT_AUTHENTICATED status from SDK auth subscription
should not allow navigation to SDK features after external logout
CXone Agent iframe should stop receiving tokens after external logout
OIDC token endpoint should accept refresh_token grant type
OIDC discovery should expose token_endpoint for refresh flow
should have OIDC config stored in localStorage after auth for refresh use
SDK should dispatch REFRESH_TOKEN_SUCCESS event on successful refresh
should maintain auth state across page reload when tokens exist
should lose auth state after reload when tokens are cleared
